optionDescriptions.sanitize: The profile applied before rendering; never render unsanitized HTML.
optionDescriptions.htmlProfile: Output dialect used when re-serializing non-HTML input.
optionDescriptions.theme: Theme tokens, so stored content matches the editor that produced it.
optionDescriptions.colorScheme: Light, dark, or follow the operating system.
optionDescriptions.mergeTagPreview: Render merge tags with these sample values instead of `{key}`.
optionDescriptions.unstyled: Prose styles only, no chrome visuals.
